text:
leah: @here Aurora-1 (model_id=aurora-1) is GA on Hosted API today. This release includes streaming v3, tool-calling v3, and improved prefix caching behaviour. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/aurora-1 :tada:

leah: Quick curl example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"aurora-1","input":"Draft a short release note for Aurora-1 GA","stream":true,"tool_call":true}'
```

samir: Heads-up: we changed the tool payload field name from `tool_input` -> `tool_args`. See migration for examples. Non-JSON tool returns will fallback to freeform text.

docs: Added a migration snippet and example client code for Node/Python. Also added a note about prefix cache invalidation: default TTL now 12h, configurable per-tenant.

infra-bot: deploy: aurora-1-stream-v3 canary rolled to us-east-1 at 1823456798. Watching token churn and p95 latency.

support: Created KB article "Aurora-1 GA: common issues" and canned Slack/Zendesk replies. Added on-call tag #aurora-1-ga.

leah: Limits to add: default streaming concurrency = 180 streams/org, max tokens/stream = 70k. Support can approve increases for enterprise customers.

ceo-bot: Exec note: congratulations team on a smooth rollout — we hit our latency SLOs in canary.

samir: Rollout plan: 0-8% canary (45m), 8-40% regional (4h), 40-100% global (18h). Rollback if error rate >1% or p95 >1.8x baseline.

leah: Customer-facing GA banner will go live in 20m. Internal sync at 14:30 PT for telemetry review. Ping me if you see anomalies. :rocket:
